title: Compose Bell links using actual support overlap and the join connection
statement: For flat link support isometries M,N and unitary Bell connection W at shared dimension d, far coefficients are M^T*W*N/sqrt(a*b*d). A full-rank flat target requires all nonzero singular values equal and the required endpoint rank. Canonical path/tree closure obeys the bottleneck/superlevel criterion.

body: Expand edge kets and contract the Bell bra to obtain the coefficient matrix; its SVD is the far Schmidt decomposition. Equal singular values give flatness, while its rank gives the actual support. On a canonical path every edge index must equal one common index below m=min d_i, giving the stated probability and rank. Every tree path has the dimension-required output iff each nonempty dimension superlevel set is connected. LOCC cannot repair a cut-rank deficit without paid crossing resources; local normalization does not create entanglement rank.
